Why Medixella

Everything you need to practise, review and improve

Past-paper questions

Questions grouped by year, subject, system and topic, so you practise what really comes in exams.

Every option explained

Learn why the right answer is right and why each wrong option is wrong, in simple words.

LUMHS Qbank

Choose your year

Each year opens into modules, subjects and topics, so you can build a block in a few taps.

First Year MBBS

Foundation, Blood, MSK, Respiratory and CVS modules. Anatomy, physiology, biochemistry and more.

Available

Second Year MBBS

Neuro, Head & Neck, GIT, Endocrine, Renal and Reproductive modules.

Available

Third Year MBBS

Pathology, Pharmacology and Forensic Medicine & Toxicology, from past papers. Community Medicine coming soon.

Available

Fourth Year MBBS

ENT, Ophthalmology, and the Medicine and Surgery department modules: Cardiology, Neurology, Psychiatry, Nephrology, Dermatology, Pulmonology, Gastroenterology, Orthopaedics, Neurosurgery, Urology and Plastic Surgery.

Available

Final Year MBBS

Medicine (9 modules plus Pulmonology and Gastroenterology), Surgery (12 modules), Paediatrics, Obstetrics and Gynaecology.

Available

How to get access

Four simple steps

Create your account

Tap "Log in", then sign up with Google or an email link.

Message us

Send the email you signed up with to us on Instagram or WhatsApp and ask how to pay.

Pay and send a screenshot

Send a screenshot of your payment together with your email.

Get activated

We activate your account. Open the app, tap "Check again", and you are in. Use it on 2 devices.

Open Medixella as an app

Add Medixella to your home screen or desktop. It opens like a normal app, in full screen, and works offline once opened.

  1. Open this page in Chrome (or Samsung Internet).
  2. Tap the menu ⋮ at the top right.
  3. Tap Install app or Add to Home screen, then Install.
  4. Open Medixella from your home screen.
  1. Open this page in Safari.
  2. Tap the Share button ⬆️ (bottom of the screen, or top right on iPad).
  3. Scroll and tap Add to Home Screen, then Add.
  4. Open Medixella from its new icon. If you get full access, send us the device ID shown inside that app.
  1. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
  2. Click the install icon ⊕ at the right end of the address bar. Or open the menu ⋮ and choose Install Medixella (Edge: Apps → Install this site as an app).
  3. Click Install. Medixella opens in its own window and gets a desktop and Start menu shortcut.
Firefox cannot install apps. Use Chrome or Edge.
  1. Safari: open this page, then choose File → Add to Dock.
  2. Chrome or Edge: click the install icon ⊕ in the address bar, or menu ⋮ → Cast, save and share → Install page as app (Edge: Apps → Install this site as an app).
  3. Open Medixella from your Dock or Launchpad.
Continue in the browser
Tip: install it from the app page itself and your access stays on that device.
